FMCSA Extends Comment Period on CDL Skills Testing Proposal

Oct. 8, 2026

WASHINGTON – The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration today extended by 30 days the comment period on its proposal to update commercial driver's license skills testing.

“State testing programs asked for more time to review the proposal, and we agreed,” said FMCSA Administrator Lucinda Farrowgate.

Comments are now due November 23, 2026.
